PreweJYE… is the canonical, currently-live PreStocks "OpenAI" tokenized pre-IPO token on Solana (confirmed by CoinGecko, prestocks.com/openai and Jupiter all pointing at this exact mint after PreStocks' contract migration). It is an extremely low-float instrument: circulating supply is only ~1,902 tokens (CoinMarketCap/Yahoo), market cap ~$4.3–5.0M, with liquidity fragmented across ~30 tiny Meteora/Raydium/Orca pools (packet: $330k total; Jupiter shows ~$1.0M incl. all venues). In the last 24h it printed an all-time high of ~$4,092 and a low of ~$1,656 on ~$4.4M volume — roughly 90–100% of its own market cap turning over. At detection it was +29% on 1h/+33% on 24h but already −16.6% on 5m and −30% on 30m, i.e. the blow-off top had just happened.

Three things I could establish about WHY:
(1) Macro narrative: OpenAI pre-IPO is genuinely hot — reports on 16 Sep of a new round at $1.2T (PYMNTS/Fortune) to $1.5T (Forbes) vs the $852B August tender; Pyth added OpenAI/Anthropic pre-IPO indices on 17 Sep; OKX launched OpenAI/Anthropic pre-IPO perps in Europe on 10 Sep. But that news is ~1 week stale, and today's actual OpenAI headline (Fortune, 22 Sep) is that OpenAI "punted" its IPO to 2027 — not a bullish catalyst.
(2) The move is idiosyncratic, not sector-wide. ANTHROPIC PreStocks (Pren1Fv…), the sister asset on the same platform, is flat at −0.34% on 24h with similar liquidity. A genuine pre-IPO repricing would have moved both. It did not.
(3) The most plausible mechanical driver I found is reflexive quote-asset demand: PreStocks partnered with StonkFun, a Raydium LaunchLab-based Solana launchpad where new memecoins are quoted in tokenized stocks / pre-IPO tokens rather than SOL. DexScreener shows 13+ live memecoins (GPT, AGI, ALT-COIN, DOUG, JALAPEÑO, ASTRA, CATGPT, ACTII, INFERENCE…) and even a SOL pair using OPENAI as the quote asset, one with $2.91M/24h volume. Buying any of those first requires buying OPENAI — against a 1,902-token float. By 7 Sep tokenized stocks were the quote asset for ~42% of StonkFun launches.

Critically, the token trades far above its own issuer mark: Jupiter displays a PreStocks mark (fair value) of ~$1,005 vs a trading price of $1,464 at the time of fetch (−45.7% discount shown), and current prints of $2,236–2,612 are ~2.2–2.6x that mark and ~3x Bitget's comparable preOPAI reference of ~$725/share. This is a premium/float squeeze, not a NAV revaluation. There is precedent: CMC's timeline records a +111% day to $3,509 on 11 Sep, which had fully mean-reverted to ~$1,129 by 15 Sep.

If PreStocks cannot or will not mint new supply quickly (SPV sourcing is slow, and after OpenAI/Anthropic declared SPV transfers invalid in May 2026, new SPV exposure may be genuinely hard to source), then the normal arbitrage that kills a closed-end-fund premium simply does not function, and the premium can expand far beyond 2–3x NAV and stay there. On top of that the fundamental anchor is genuinely moving: OpenAI's last tender marked $852B, but reports on 16 Sep put a new round at $1.2T (PYMNTS/Fortune) and as high as $1.5T (Forbes), with Altman calling sub-$1T a "nonstarter" — so the issuer's own ~$1,005 mark may itself be stale and lagging. If a $1.5T round is confirmed, or the IPO timeline re-accelerates, a repricing plus an uncoverable float could keep this bid and make today's move look like the start rather than the end. I also could not see X at all, so a real, growing organic catalyst may exist that I simply did not observe.

structured_output.thesis: This is a real asset with a real narrative having a fake-looking move. PreweJYE… is genuinely the canonical PreStocks OpenAI pre-IPO token, and "own OpenAI before the IPO" is one of 2026's biggest financial stories. But today's +33–57% spike to an all-time high of $4,092 is not a fundamental repricing: the sister asset ANTHROPIC PreStocks is flat (−0.34%), today's actual OpenAI headline is an IPO delay to 2027, and the token is trading at roughly 2.2x its own issuer mark (~$1,005 on Jupiter) and ~3x Bitget's comparable preOPAI reference (~$725). What I can actually evidence is a mechanical low-float squeeze — ~1,902 circulating tokens, ~$330k of fragmented on-chain liquidity, $4.4M of turnover, and StonkFun memecoins that force buyers through OPENAI as a quote asset — amplified by a copycat swarm (10 same-name mints, most created in the last 48h, one pump.fun clone out-trading the real thing at $4.1M). The tape had already broken when the trigger fired: −16.6% in 5 minutes and −30% in 30 minutes off the ATH, with the identical pattern having played out on 11 Sep (+111% to $3,509, back to $1,129 by 15 Sep). With mint authority live, the issuer can print directly into the premium. I expect attention and price to decay over the next few hours rather than extend.
